calibration.method: Bayesian cubic-spline GAM with group-specific smooths
calibration.Q_semantics: complete conditional response-error second moment; fresh AI variance included once

diagnostics.uncertainty_scope: Model-based under fixed spline basis, priors and known simulated noise; not a distribution-free extrapolation guarantee.

geometry.description: Ground metric = absolute normalized-age difference + 0.5 for different groups; finite cross-group transport allowed.
geometry.tolerance_units: normalized-age equivalent cost; multiply by 62 for age-year-equivalent cost (the 0.5 cross-group penalty equals 31 years of age-distance cost)

unweighted.name: Unweighted human responses
unweighted.conditional_mse_scope: Fitted bias-posterior conditional MSE using simulated true f for assessment; not oracle MSE under the fixed simulator bias.

human_only.name: Optimally reweighted humans under the same representation constraint

result.conditional_mse_scope: Fitted bias-posterior conditional MSE using simulated true f for assessment; not oracle MSE under the fixed simulator bias.

frontier_note: Same data, calibration posterior, Q, candidate pool and budget for every row. Increasing tolerance enlarges the feasible set; optimal response risk cannot increase. Infeasible rows are explicit.
empirical_scope: One seeded synthetic scenario; not evidence of out-of-sample validity or uniformly better realized estimation.
